final_text:
Added profile pictures with end-to-end support:

- Users can now enter a profile picture URL during sign-up.
- The database stores `avatar_url` for each user.
- Auth/user/post/comment APIs now return `avatarUrl` / `authorAvatarUrl`.
- Post and comment UIs show the avatar next to the author name.
- The navbar and profile page also display avatars.
- Added styling for avatar images and fallback initials.

Note: I kept avatars URL-based rather than file upload, since the app currently has no file storage pipeline.
